$comment: What scripts/privacy-scan.mjs allows in the shipped main.js. Every entry says why it can't send anything off the device. Adding an entry is a privacy decision: review the code first, and say in the PR why it is safe.

packages.@mariozechner/pi-ai: Pi harness model layer. Only its openai-completions provider is bundled (other providers and the cloud model catalog are stubbed in esbuild.config.mjs); it talks to the model built in src/agent/pi/PiChatAgent.ts, whose base URL is the user's server URL.
packages.@mariozechner/pi-agent-core: Pi agent loop. No network code of its own; calls the pi-ai stream function.
packages.@modelcontextprotocol/sdk: Built-in MCP server and client, joined by the in-memory transport only (no HTTP, SSE or stdio transport is bundled).
packages.openai: HTTP client pi-ai uses for OpenAI-compatible servers. Sends only to the baseURL it is given (the user's server URL; PiChatAgent refuses an empty one, which would fall back to api.openai.com).
packages.ajv: JSON schema validation for MCP. Never configured with loadSchema, so it never fetches remote $refs.
packages.ajv-formats: Format validators for ajv. Regexes only.
packages.zod: Schema library used by the MCP SDK. No network code.
packages.fast-uri: URI parsing for ajv. No network code.
packages.json-schema-traverse: Schema walking for ajv. No network code.
packages.partial-json: Parses streamed tool-call JSON. No network code.

externals.obsidian: The Obsidian API. Its requestUrl is only called from src/services/LLMService.ts with the user's server URL.
externals.node:fs: pi-ai env-api-keys.js: existsSync for local cloud credential files and a Bun-only /proc/self/environ read. Local file reads; the plugin always passes its own API key so these paths aren't used for requests.
externals.node:os: pi-ai env-api-keys.js: homedir() for the same local credential check. No network.
externals.node:path: pi-ai env-api-keys.js: join() for the same local credential check. No network.

node_modules/openai/client.mjs.reason: Sends chat requests to the configured baseURL (the user's local server).

node_modules/openai/core/streaming.mjs.reason: Reads the streamed response of that same request.

node_modules/openai/internal/shims.mjs.reason: Picks globalThis.fetch for the client above.

node_modules/openai/internal/uploads.mjs.reason: Type checks for Response objects; the plugin never uploads files.

src/services/LLMService.ts.reason: Model list and status checks against the user's server URL only. 'fetch' appears in error-message text.

src/main.ts.reason: Opens the review page, the GitHub repo or the bug report page in the user's browser, only when they click those buttons.

node_modules/@mariozechner/pi-ai/dist/en.reason: import(specifier) where the specifier is one of the constants node:fs, node:os, node:path (checked under externals).

node_modules/@mariozechner/pi-ai/dist/pr.reason: import('./amazon-bedrock.js') for the AWS Bedrock provider, only when a model's api is bedrock-converse-stream. The plugin's model is always openai-completions, and that file is not shipped next to main.js, so the import can't load anything.

hosts.github.com: Links the user can click (bug report, repo, help text) and MCP SDK doc strings. Nothing is fetched.
hosts.www.obsidianstats.com: Review link in the review prompt; opens only on the user's click.
hosts.lmstudio.ai: Setup instructions text telling the user where to get LM Studio.
hosts.api.openai.com: openai client's default baseURL. Never used: PiChatAgent always passes an explicit http(s) server URL and refuses an empty one.
hosts.docs.expo.dev: Text in an openai error message.
hosts.example.com: Example strings in MCP SDK and typebox.
hosts.json-schema.org: JSON schema $schema identifiers. Identifiers only, never fetched.
hosts.raw.githubusercontent.com: ajv's $data meta-schema $id. An identifier, never fetched.
